WatchedMovie.title: WatchedMovie
WatchedMovie.description: A movie marked as watched by an authenticated user, including TMDB metadata, watch timestamp, and personal rating/note.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this watched entry.

releaseDate.description: Movie release date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

userRating.description: User's personal 1-5 star rating (0 when unrated).

note.description: User's personal watch note or short review.

genres.description: List of up to 10 genre names.

watchedAt.description: Server timestamp when the movie was marked as watched (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest rating or note update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/watched/{movieId}.description: Per-user subcollection of watched movies keyed by TMDB movieId.
